what.value: Implements witnessed auto-promotion of clock-in targets in the futon3c agent-chat/REPL surface, with durable clock decisions and dispatch lineage.
what.quote: The going-forward clock-in (`C-substrate-completion §8.1`) is manual: `cr/cx new <target>` or `agent-chat-clock-in`/`-excurse`.
